Called by Inventory (depth 2). Found invoice 501 unpaid and 3 days overdue and prepared payment request #1 ($840).
Drafted the reply offering M, L or XL without promising a restock date or mentioning the invoice.

Quoted 10% and 15% and prepared price override request #3 at 10% ($1,044.00 total, 57.9% margin).
Found 8 of 20 on hand (12 short), chose Bulldog Print Co (5-day lead) and prepared PO request #4 for 12 units ($264, arriving about 2026-09-05).
Drafted the reply: 8 available now, 12 estimated around Sept 5, discount pending approval, other sizes available.

human_approvals.details: 10.0% off 20 x CC-HOOD-NAVY M: $52.20/unit (list $58.00), total $1,044.00, margin 57.9%. Reason: Recommend a reasonable 10% bulk discount for 20 hoodies; the quote shows a 57.9% margin, above the 30% minimum.

Order 12 x CC-HOOD-NAVY M from Bulldog Print Co at $22.00/unit; arrives about 2026-09-05 if approved today. Reason: Stock check shows 8 size M hoodies on hand against demand for 20, leaving a shortfall of 12.

tickets.customer_message: Yale AI Club, we currently have 8 of the 20 navy hoodies you requested in size M, so we're short 12. We have other sizes available: S (4), L (14), and XL (6). A 12-hoodie size M restock is awaiting approval; if approved today, we estimate it would arrive around September 5, 2026. We're also proposing a 10% bulk discount, pending approval, so it isn't final yet. Let us know if you'd like to consider the available sizes or wait for our confirmation on the restock and discount.
